name: Polish Open 2007
information:
Preregistration via internet is required and closes September 09, 2007 (Sunday). On-site registration is also required and will be able on September 15, 2007 (Saturday) morning at the latest.
Registration fee: 10 PLN (about 3 EUR).
Competition starts at 9:15am on Suturday.
Organisation committee, consisting of:
Wadowickie Stowarzyszenie Milosnikow kostki Rubika (local Rubik's Cube Club)
Zespol Szkol Publicznych nr 2 w Wadowicach (school)
